agent_note: 5 logical agents sharing one unlearned model backend; NOT independently unlearned checkpoints
cohort_note: the concept registry and the deleted baseline memory come from 'discovery' (20 forgotten concepts); the questions come from 'retain_utility' (45 concepts)

detector_gates.note: the gates this study's threshold was selected under. `all_gates_passed: false` is the honest state of Detector v2 and is why `detector.status` is diagnostic — the operating point is known, and known not to be good enough

model.description: released Leak-k RULE-NPO forget10 baseline; five logical agents share one handle
model.name: rule_npo_1b

protocol_note: graph_flow: the request gate is held CONSTANT across every arm — no arm inspects the incoming question — so what is measured is whether forgotten information generated or introduced after the initial boundary can propagate.

topology.description: five agents; two branches recombine at an integrator before the finalizer
topology.name: diamond5

uses_gold_answers_note: no injected content; every message is a model output
